statement: A running model, not a calibrated one, and thinner than the wisteria model it is derived from: there was no prototype of this plant to carry numbers over from, so most are copied from wisteria or are placeholders. None has been measured on a plant. Use its output to compare scenarios and to show what a design implies, not to predict dates, sizes or loads.

phenology.budburstDoy.basis: Shoots are taken to start in mid March, soon after the late-winter prune. No dated source.

phenology.growthEndDoy.basis: Extension is taken to end in early September. No dated source.

phenology.autumnColourDoy.basis: Copied from the Wisteria sinensis model for want of anything better. Not a measurement or a description of this plant.

phenology.leafFallDoy.basis: Deciduous; leafless in winter (RHS). Dates are a placeholder.

phenology.floralInitiationDoy.basis: Flowers on the year’s own growth (RHS group 3), so buds are taken to form on that growth a few weeks before flowering. No dated source.

phenology.flowerOpenDoy.basis: Flowers open in succession across the RHS flowering envelope of July to August (4 July to 20 August).

phenology.petalFallDoy.basis: Placed at the end of the RHS flowering envelope of July to August (13 August to 7 September).

phenology.flowerLastsDays.basis: How long one flower lasts. A placeholder.

extension.leaderMPerSeason.basis: RHS: group 3 clematis are cut to 15-30 cm every February and are back in their 2.5 to 4 m size band by flowering, so a stem makes about that much in a season. Derived, not measured.

extension.lateralMPerSeasonByOrder.basis: Scaled down from the leader rate. Not measured.

extension.whipMPerSeason.basis: Every year the old stems throw new side shoots, which is where an established plant makes its leaves and flowers once the framework has stopped extending. On a plant cut down each February there are no old stems, so this only shows on one left unpruned. Rate is a placeholder.

extension.establishmentFactorByYear.basis: Slower while it roots in. A placeholder.

architecture.trunkStemStartYears.basis: Three stems from the base in the first season. A placeholder.

architecture.nurseryCaneM.basis: Planted cut back, as is usual for clematis. Not measured.

architecture.leaderLengthM.basis: The RHS ultimate-size band used as a cap on stem length measured from the ground. A height band is not a route length, so this is a placeholder.

architecture.lateralLengthMByOrder.basis: Scaled down from the leader. Not measured.

architecture.lateralLengthSpread.basis: Copied from the Wisteria sinensis model for want of anything better. Not a measurement or a description of this plant.

attachment.maxGraspDiameterMm.basis: No measurement exists. A leaf stalk a few centimetres long is taken to clasp nothing stouter than this: a cable qualifies, timber of any size here does not, and the plant has to be tied to it.

attachment.minPitchM.basis: Copied from the Wisteria sinensis model for want of anything better. Not a measurement or a description of this plant.

attachment.pitchPerCircumference.basis: Copied from the Wisteria sinensis model for want of anything better. Not a measurement or a description of this plant.

organs.leavesPerNode.basis: Clematis bear their leaves in opposite pairs. A character of the genus, not sourced here.

organs.spurChance.basis: No spurs: old stems are bare, which is why group 3 clematis are cut down each year.

organs.spurLengthM.basis: Not applicable to this plant; present because every model carries every parameter.

organs.spurLeafCount.basis: No spurs are modelled for this plant.

organs.racemeLengthM.basis: Width of a single flower. A placeholder.

organs.whipShareOfNodes.basis: Every year the old stems throw new side shoots, which is where an established plant makes its leaves and flowers once the framework has stopped extending. The share of nodes that do so is a placeholder.

organs.whipsPerYearMax.basis: A cap on new side shoots a year. A placeholder.

organs.whipLengthM.basis: Length of a year’s side shoot. A placeholder.

organs.leafLifespanYears.basis: Copied from the Wisteria sinensis model for want of anything better. Not a measurement or a description of this plant.

flowering.competenceYears.basis: Group 3 clematis flower on the year’s growth and are taken to do so from the first summer. A placeholder.

flowering.maturityRamp.basis: Half strength in the planting year. A placeholder.

flowering.spurFloralChance.basis: Not applicable to this plant; present because every model carries every parameter.

flowering.unprunedFactor.basis: Not applicable to this plant; present because every model carries every parameter.

flowering.currentSeasonFlowersPerM.basis: Flowers per metre of the year’s growth. A placeholder.

flowering.currentSeasonMinShootM.basis: A shoot shorter than this is taken not to flower. A placeholder.

pruning.summerLeavesKept.basis: Not applicable to this plant; present because every model carries every parameter.

pruning.winterBudsKept.basis: Not applicable to this plant; present because every model carries every parameter.

regrowth.shootsPerCut.basis: RHS: cut back to just above a pair of strong buds; each stub is taken to give one or two shoots.
